lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Find the hazard on the table. Tap it.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: A fire hazard can start a fire, or trap us inside.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Battery candles are safer than real candles. Same glow, no flame.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Find the hazard in this corner. Tap it.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: The corner with the lamp

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Paper burns fast. Keep it far away from hot lamps.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Find the hazard by the back door. Tap it.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: The back door

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Fine. Smaller dance floor.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: A blocked door traps us inside. Doors must stay clear.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Find the hazard by the lights. Tap it.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: The wall with the party lights

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Too many plugs make a socket hot. Fewer plugs are safer.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Four hazards, all fixed. That is the first step: looking for fire hazards.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: What should he do? Tap one.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: The mummy cannot see the fire hazards. Tell him what to do.

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Look at my lantern. A real candle!

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Same glow and no flame. Much safer!

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: What should he do? Tap one.

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: My paper bats are on the lamp. So cosy!

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: On the wall! Paper burns fast near hot lamps.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: What should he do? Tap one.

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: The sofa is against the back door. More dance floor!

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Fine. Smaller dance floor, but a clear door.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: What should he do? Tap one.

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Six plugs in one socket. So many lights!

lines.speaker: mummy
lines.text: Fewer plugs, cooler socket. Much safer.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Four hazards, and you fixed every one. That is the first step: looking for fire hazards.
